en.bdb: Service to the true Guru provides all fruits -

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਧਾਤਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਰ ਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਝੂਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: paaras dhaat ka(n)chan karai hoi manoor na ka(n)chan jhoorai|

en.bdb: Philosopher's stone transforms metal into gold but the dross of iron does not become gold and is hence disappointed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਬੋਹੈ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਬਾਂਸ ਨਿਗੰਧ ਨ ਬੁਹੈ ਹਜੂਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: baavan bohai banaasapat baa(n)s niga(n)dh na buhai hajoorai|

en.bdb: Sandalwood makes the whole vegetation fragrant but the nearby bamboo remains devoid of fragrance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਹਸ ਗੁਣ ਕਲਰ ਖੇਤਿ ਨ ਬੀਜ ਉਗੂਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: khetee ja(n)mai sahas gun kalar khet na beej ugoorai|

en.bdb: On sowing seed, the earth produces thousand times more but in the alkaline soil the seed does not germinate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਲੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਝ ਸੁਝਾਇ ਹਜੂਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: auloo sujh na sujhiee satigur sujh sujhai hajoorai|

en.bdb: The owl cannot see (the sun) but the true Guru bestowing the understanding about that Lord makes one see Him really and clearly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਚੂਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee beejai so lunai satigur sevaa sabh fal choorai|

en.bdb: Only that which is sown in the earth is reaped but by serving the true Guru all sorts of fruits are attained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਦੂਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: bohith pavai su nikalai satigur saadh asaadh na dhoorai|

en.bdb: As whoever boards the ship gets across, similarly the true Guru makes no distinction between the virtuous
And the wicked and makes even animals and ghosts follow a godly life.
